Description: Verify student dashboard loads with greeting counts Up Next Recent Activity
Test Steps:
1. Log in as provisioned student scroll privacy notice to bottom tap I Accept tap Sign In (Skip onboarding if shown).
2. Land on the Home tab.
3. Verify greeting hero status line Up Next card and Recent Activity list render.
Test Data: Valid student account with existing submissions
Expected Results: Greeting plus name submission counts revise-first Up Next recent activity visible; no errors

Description: Verify Up Next prioritizes revision and exposes Resubmit entry
Test Steps:
1. On the Home tab locate the Up Next section.
2. Verify a revision_required paper tops the list.
3. Tap Resubmit revision on that card.
Test Data: Account with at least 1 revision_required paper
Expected Results: Up Next shows revise-first ordering; tap navigates to SubmitResearch hydrated for that paper

Description: Verify Recent Activity deep-link and pull-refresh
Test Steps:
1. On the Home tab tap an item in Recent Activity.
2. Verify it opens the linked paper.
3. Go back and pull-to-refresh the dashboard.
Test Data: Existing notification linked to a paper
Expected Results: Tap opens ResearchDetail for that paper; refresh reloads content without error

Description: Verify dashboard empty / all-caught-up fallback state
Test Steps:
1. Log in as a student with no actionable papers.
2. Observe the Up Next and recommendations area on the Home tab.
Expected Results: Shows all-caught-up state with Recommended For You fallback list instead of Up Next

Description: Verify full submit wizard with valid PDF and metadata
Test Steps:
1. Go to the Papers tab and tap the Submit research FAB.
2. On Step 1 tap Upload your paper and pick a valid PDF.
3. On Step 2 enter title abstract and keywords.
4. On Step 3 pick category department to program and faculty adviser.
5. On Step 4 optionally add a co-author.
6. Tap Review and submit tick all checklist items then tap Confirm and submit.
Test Data: PDF up to 10MB; title plus abstract 150-250 words; valid category/dept/program/adviser
Expected Results: Paper submits with success notice; app returns to Papers/Dashboard and the new submission appears in My Research

Description: Verify file picker restricts selection to PDF only
Test Steps:
1. Open SubmitResearch Step 1.
2. Tap Upload your paper to open the device file picker.
3. Observe non-PDF files (JPG DOCX PPTX) in the picker.
4. Attempt to tap a non-PDF file then tap a PDF file.
Test Data: Folder with JPG DOCX PPTX and PDF files
Expected Results: Non-PDF files appear disabled/greyed and cannot be selected; only PDF files are selectable; no file attaches until a PDF is picked and Continue stays disabled

Description: Verify oversize file is rejected
Test Steps:
1. Open SubmitResearch Step 1.
2. Attempt to pick a PDF larger than the policy max.
Expected Results: Inline error "File too large ... Max ...MB"; file is not accepted

Description: Verify Continue is blocked on incomplete required metadata
Test Steps:
1. Advance through Steps 2-3 leaving title abstract category or adviser empty.
2. Observe the footer buttons.
Expected Results: Continue / Review and submit stays disabled until title abstract category and adviser are complete

Description: Verify file can be removed and replaced
Test Steps:
1. On Step 1 with a file attached tap Remove.
2. Pick a different valid PDF.
Expected Results: File chip clears on Remove; replacement attaches and policy line (.pdf - Max 10 MB) still shows

Description: Verify manage co-authors search add remove external notes
Test Steps:
1. Go to Step 4 Co-authors.
2. Type at least 2 characters in student search and wait for results.
3. Tap Plus on a result to add the chip.
4. Tap Remove on the chip.
5. Enter external/non-system author notes.
Expected Results: Debounced results show fullName/email with Check vs Plus states; add creates chip remove deletes it; external notes persist

Description: Verify checklist gate blocks submit until complete
Test Steps:
1. Complete Steps 1-3 and tap Review and submit.
2. Leave one checklist item unticked and observe Confirm.
3. Tick all items.
Expected Results: Confirm and submit stays disabled until file title abstract category and adviser items are all ticked

Description: Verify resubmit for revision_required with optional file
Test Steps:
1. From Dashboard Up Next a Papers card or ResearchDetail tap Resubmit revision on a revision_required paper.
2. Verify the reviewer revision-notes card and hydrated fields.
3. Keep the current file (do not re-pick) update title/notes.
4. Tick the checklist and submit.
Expected Results: Opens Resubmit Research showing reviewer notes with "Keeping current file"; success shows "Research resubmitted" and the updated status shows on return to Papers

Description: Verify My Submissions list loads newest-first with status cards
Test Steps:
1. Log in as student.
2. Tap the Papers tab.
3. Verify the subtitle counts and status cards.
Expected Results: Searchable newest-first list with author/co-author status chip stage and date; skeletons resolve to cards

Description: Verify search filters by title abstract keyword
Test Steps:
1. On the Papers tab type a query in "Search your papers".
2. Verify the narrowed list.
3. Clear the query.
Test Data: Keyword matching one paper; non-matching string
Expected Results: List narrows to title/abstract/keyword matches; no-match shows "No papers found"; clearing restores the full list

Description: Verify segment filters All / In Review / Needs Revision / Approved
Test Steps:
1. On the Papers tab tap the All pill.
2. Tap In Review.
3. Tap Needs Revision.
4. Tap Approved.
Expected Results: Each pill shows only its group (Active / Published / Revise-required mapping); counts correct

Description: Verify submission detail shows status timeline and feedback
Test Steps:
1. Tap a card on the Papers tab to open ResearchDetail.
2. Verify metadata status and submission timeline.
3. Tap Feedback (N) to open the annotations panel.
Expected Results: Detail shows category/title/authors/date/views owner-gated timeline with reviewer role/comments/date and the feedback panel opens

Description: Verify invitations list loads
Test Steps:
1. Tap the bell icon in the TopBar.
2. On the Activity screen tap the Invites chip.
3. Verify the invitation cards.
Expected Results: Invitations header plus cards render; expired ones show a muted Expired pill with no actions

Description: Verify accept of a pending invitation
Test Steps:
1. Open Activity to Invites.
2. Tap Accept on a pending unexpired card.
3. Wait for the action to finish and refresh.
Expected Results: Card confirms acceptance (Accepting spinner to done); invite leaves the actionable state on refresh

Description: Verify decline of a pending invitation
Test Steps:
1. Open Activity to Invites.
2. Tap Decline on a pending card.
3. Confirm and refresh.
Expected Results: Decline confirms; invite leaves the actionable state

Description: Verify expired and empty invitation states
Test Steps:
1. Open Activity to Invites on an account with an expired invite.
2. Verify no Accept/Decline actions exist on it.
3. Open Invites on an account with zero invites.
Test Data: Expired invite; account with no invites
Expected Results: Expired card is disabled with Expired pill; empty inbox shows "No invitations" state

Description: Verify faculty dashboard loads totals workload and Action Required
Test Steps:
1. Log in as faculty and land on the Home tab.
2. Verify the hero status line.
3. Verify the workload donut and Action Required list.
Expected Results: Assigned totals Needs Review / In Revision / Forwarded / Approved chart and Up Next cards render correctly

Description: Verify dashboard shortcuts route to the filtered queue
Test Steps:
1. On the faculty Home tab tap a workload legend segment.
2. Verify the queue opens with that filter.
3. Go back and tap See all N pending.
Expected Results: Legend tap navigates to FacultyReview with the matching initialFilter; See all opens the needs_review queue

Description: Verify dashboard all-caught-up empty state
Test Steps:
1. Log in as faculty with no pending reviews.
2. Observe the Action Required area.
Expected Results: Shows the all-caught-up state instead of action cards

Description: Verify review queue loads paged papers with refresh
Test Steps:
1. Tap the Review tab.
2. Verify the title and "N submissions" subtitle.
3. Scroll to the end to trigger the next page.
4. Pull-to-refresh.
Expected Results: Queue loads 20 per page with footer skeleton then more cards; refresh reloads without error

Description: Verify queue search with no-results and clear
Test Steps:
1. On the Review tab type a title query in "Search by title author or keyword".
2. Enter a nonsense string.
3. Tap X to clear.
Expected Results: Debounced search narrows to matches; nonsense shows the no-results empty state; X restores the full queue

Description: Verify queue filter pills
Test Steps:
1. On the Review tab tap Needs Review.
2. Tap Revisions.
3. Tap Forwarded.
4. Tap Approved.
5. Tap All.
Expected Results: Each pill filters correctly (needs_review = pending_faculty plus revision_required; revisions; forwarded = pending_dean/chair/editor/admin; approved = approved plus published; all = everything)

Description: Verify queue card opens the review workspace
Test Steps:
1. On the Review tab tap any queue card.
2. Verify the destination screen.
Expected Results: Navigates to FacultyReviewDetail (Paper Review header) for that paperId

Description: Verify review workspace renders with history and decision gating
Test Steps:
1. Open FacultyReviewDetail from the queue.
2. Verify title/meta revision/rejection notices inline PDF abstract keywords and review-history timeline.
3. Repeat on an already-decided paper.
Expected Results: All sections render; Your decision buttons appear only when status is pending_faculty otherwise read-only

Description: Verify page-linked note annotation with show/hide
Test Steps:
1. In the workspace PDF tap the pencil Add a note button.
2. Tap the page to place the pin.
3. Type a comment and save.
4. Toggle the Eye show/hide button.
5. Tap the pin to open the panel.
Expected Results: Pin drops and saves without error; Eye toggles pins; pin tap opens AnnotationPanel with jump-to-page

Description: Verify approve forwards to dean/chair and requires an assignee
Test Steps:
1. In the workspace tap Approve.
2. Attempt Approve with no assignee selected.
3. Pick a dean/chair add an optional note tap Approve.
4. Confirm on the verification card.
Test Data: Dean/chair roster; note up to 500 chars
Expected Results: Empty assignee is blocked ("Select a dean..."); with assignee approval forwards the paper with a Decision Submitted overlay and back navigation

Description: Verify reject requires a reason
Test Steps:
1. In the workspace tap Reject.
2. Attempt Reject with a blank reason.
3. Enter a reason tap Reject.
4. Confirm on the verification card.
Expected Results: Blank is blocked ("A rejection reason is required"); with reason rejection submits and the paper leaves the actionable queue

Description: Verify request-revision requires notes
Test Steps:
1. In the workspace tap Revision.
2. Attempt Send back with blank notes.
3. Enter revision notes tap Send back.
4. Confirm on the verification card.
Expected Results: Blank is blocked ("Revision notes are required"); with notes the paper returns to revision_required and surfaces in the student Up Next
